title: Universal Destiny 1 activity, world, encounter and asset extraction program

scope.platform_reference: PS4 retail Rise of Iron-era corpus
scope.target: Every source-discoverable activity/world, including patrol destinations, story missions, strikes, raids, social spaces, arenas and other activity variants

attrs.proof_policy: source-layout and exact-retail ownership edges only

nodes.label: All current named D1 activity roots
Named activity -> S6E stages -> F603 resources -> placements/controllers/actors
Activity graph -> models, rigs, animation, materials, textures, effects, audio -> deterministic export

assertions.claim: The checksum-pinned universal PS4 member catalog contains 337 package families in the ordinary base-package namespace and is the current remote corpus for activity-root discovery.

The generic activity-stage resource matrix reproduces moon_raid_1 without one-owner assumptions: 509 unique F603 resources occur 547 times across 40 stages in 10 S6E containers, with 19 resources shared between stages.

All current D1 activities should be extracted through reusable schemas and ownership rules rather than activity-specific code, ultimately producing complete world geometry, placements, actors, controllers, animations, materials, effects and audio for maps, missions, strikes, raids, social spaces and other activity variants.

details.policy: unique resources and serialized stage occurrences are represented separately

frontiers.question: What is the exact current retail inventory of source-named D1 activity roots across all 337 package families?
frontiers.next_proof: Complete the remote named-table scan, preserve aliases, and checksum-pin the inventory artifact.

frontiers.question: Can every admitted activity root be processed through one deterministic orchestration path?
frontiers.next_proof: Create a generic runner that performs activity traversal, F603 classification, S6E probing, shared-resource matrix construction, scripted-actor census and dependency closure from one inventory record.

frontiers.question: How are every activity's static world geometry, map data layers and environment dependencies assembled into one exportable scene?
frontiers.next_proof: Generalize the source-validated Tower/static map pipelines into an activity-root-driven world assembler and validate on structurally different destinations.

frontiers.question: What are the remaining EntityResource class-pair schemas used for objectives, squads, phase controls, volumes, devices and special bosses?
frontiers.next_proof: Reverse each class pair across multiple activities using source layouts and cross-activity calibration; never infer role from Crota-only names.

frontiers.question: Can model/rig/animation/material/texture/effect/audio dependencies be closed automatically for every activity-owned entity and world object?
frontiers.next_proof: Promote solved entity, model, material, animation, shader, effect and audio schemas into a dependency walker with exact ownership provenance and deterministic export assembly.
